nodes.label: alembic upgrade head on api start
nodes.norm_label: alembic upgrade head on api start
nodes.rationale: The api command runs 'alembic upgrade head' before uvicorn so the database schema always matches the running code — the same Alembic revision chain that backup files record for restore gating.

nodes.label: BACKUP_DIR env (default /backups)
nodes.rationale: Points api and scanner at the directory where scheduled snapshots are written/listed; defaults to /backups which is exactly where the backupdata volume is mounted.

nodes.label: BACKUP_INTERVAL_MINUTES env (default 0)
nodes.rationale: Recurring backup interval in minutes on both api and scanner; 0 disables scheduling (manual backups only).

nodes.label: BACKUP_KEEP env (default 14)
nodes.rationale: Retention count for scheduled snapshot files, bounding disk use of the backupdata volume.

nodes.label: backupdata volume
nodes.rationale: Named docker volume mounted at /backups on both api and scanner so the worker can write scheduled snapshots and the API can list/serve them; it lives and dies with the host, so files must be copied off-server for real disaster recovery.

nodes.label: SCAN_INTERVAL_MINUTES env (default 0)
nodes.rationale: Recurring scan interval on api (validation/rate-limit) and scanner (worker execution); the direct analogue of BACKUP_INTERVAL_MINUTES for scan scheduling.
